We need to do the reverse operation of differentiation, which is integration. So, we integrate [MATH: a(t)] with respect to [MATH: t\mathbin{:}]

We evaluate the velocity at time [MATH: t=1\,\textrm{s}\mathbin{:}]

[MATH: v(1)|= − 2e^{− 1} + 2(1)^{3} − 2; = − 2e^{− 1} + 2 − 2; = − (2)/(e)m/s]

Finally, since the speed is equal to [MATH: |v(t)|,] we conclude that the speed of the particle is [MATH: \dfrac 2 e\,\textrm{m/s}.]
